title: Echo and Machine
author: Edmund Coldharbour
blurb: Lior Eriksen, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
